arxiv-2106-12693.title: Deep Learning for Network Traffic Classification
arxiv-2106-12693.creator: Niloofar Bayat, Weston Jackson, Derrick Liu
arxiv-2106-12693.description: Abstract Monitoring network traffic to identify content, services, and applications is an active research topic in network traffic control systems. While modern firewalls provide the capability to decrypt packets, this is not appealing for privacy advocates. Hence, identifying any information from encrypted traffic is a challenging task.

arxiv-2107-04242.title: Gravitational Wave From Axion-like Particle Inflation
arxiv-2107-04242.creator: Wei Cheng, Tao Qian, Qing Yu, Hua Zhou, Rui-Yu Zhou
arxiv-2107-04242.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the Axion-like Particle inflation by applying the multi-nature inflation model, where the end of inflation is achieved through the phase transition (PT). The events of PT should not be less than 200 200 , which results in the free parameter n ≥ 404 n\geq 404 .

arxiv-2205-03035.title: Boundary Condition Analysis of First and Second Order Topological Insulators
arxiv-2205-03035.creator: Xi Wu, Taro Kimura
arxiv-2205-03035.description: Abstract We analytically study boundary conditions of the Dirac fermion models on a lattice, which describe the first and second order topological insulators. We obtain the dispersion relations of the edge and hinge states by solving these boundary conditions, and clarify that the Hamiltonian symmetry may provide a constraint on the boundary condition.

arxiv-2304-10471.title: WISDOM Project – XV. Giant Molecular Clouds in the Central Region of the Barred Spiral Galaxy NGC 5806 2022 WISDOM Project – XV. Giant Molecular Clouds in the Central Region of the Barred Spiral Galaxy NGC 5806 – References
arxiv-2304-10471.creator: Woorak Choi, Lijie Liu, Martin Bureau, Michele Cappellari, Timothy A. Davis, Jindra Gensior, Fu-Heng Liang, Anan Lu, Thomas G. Williams, Aeree Chung
arxiv-2304-10471.description: Abstract We present high spatial resolution ( ≈ 24 \approx 24 pc) Atacama Large Millimeter/sub-millimeter Array 12 CO(2-1) observations of the central region of the nearby barred spiral galaxy NGC 5806. NGC 5806 has a highly structured molecular gas distribution with a clear nucleus, a nuclear ring and offset dust lanes.

arxiv-2304-12943.title: Generating robust counterfactual explanations
arxiv-2304-12943.creator: Victor Guyomard, Françoise Fessant, Thomas Guyet, Tassadit Bouadi, Alexandre Termier
arxiv-2304-12943.description: Abstract Counterfactual explanations have become a mainstay of the XAI field. This particularly intuitive statement allows the user to understand what small but necessary changes would have to be made to a given situation in order to change a model prediction. The quality of a counterfactual depends on several criteria: realism, actionability, validity, robustness, etc.

arxiv-2502-16028.title: Autonomous Agricultural Monitoring with Aerial Drones and RF Energy-Harvesting Sensor Tags
arxiv-2502-16028.creator: Paul S. Kudyba and Haijian Sun
arxiv-2502-16028.description: Abstract In precision agriculture and plant science, there is an increasing demand for wireless sensors that are easy to deploy, maintain, and monitor. This paper investigates a novel approach that leverages recent advances in extremely low-power wireless communication and sensing, as well as the rapidly increasing availability of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) platforms.

arxiv-2503-15587.title: Slitless Areal Pure-Parallel HIgh-Redshift Emission Survey (SAPPHIRES): Early Data Release of Deep JWST/NIRCam Images and Spectra in MACS J0416 Parallel Field Facilities: JWST(NIRCam)
arxiv-2503-15587.creator: Fengwu Sun, Yoshinobu Fudamoto, Xiaojing Lin, Jakob M. Helton, Tiger Yu-Yang Hsiao, Eiichi Egami, Arshia Akhtarkavan, Andrew J. Bunker, Zheng Cai, Christa DeCoursey, Daniel J. Eisenstein, Xiaohui Fan, Yuichi Harikane, Zhiyuan Ji, Xiangyu Jin, Weizhe Liu, Yichen Liu, Zheng Ma, Roberto Maiolino, Masam
arxiv-2503-15587.description: Abstract We present the early data release (EDR) of SAPPHIRES , a JWST Cycle-3 Treasury imaging and spectroscopic survey using the powerful NIRCam wide-field slitless spectroscopic (WFSS) mode in pure parallel. SAPPHIRES will obtain NIRCam imaging and WFSS data in many cosmological deep fields totaling a telescope charged time of 709 hours (557-hour exposures).

arxiv-2505-03818.title: Program Semantic Inequivalence Game with Large Language Models
arxiv-2505-03818.creator: Antonio Valerio Miceli-Barone, Vaishak Belle, Ali Payani
arxiv-2505-03818.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) can achieve strong performance on everyday coding tasks, but they can fail on complex tasks that require non-trivial reasoning about program semantics. Finding training examples to teach LLMs to solve these tasks can be challenging.

arxiv-2505-06732.title: Deep Neural Networks for Cross-Energy Particle Identification at RHIC and LHC
arxiv-2505-06732.creator: O. M. Khalaf, A. M. Hamed
arxiv-2505-06732.description: Abstract This work demonstrates the application of a deep neural network for particle identification in the high transverse momentum regime. A model trained on simulated Large Hadron Collider (LHC) proton-proton collisions ( s = 13 ​ TeV \sqrt{s}=13\,\mathrm{TeV} ) is used to classify nine distinct particles using seven kinematic-level features.

arxiv-2510-20288.title: Smoothed Analysis of Online Metric Matching with a Single Sample: Beyond Metric Distortion
arxiv-2510-20288.creator: Yingxi Li, Ellen Vitercik, Mingwei Yang
arxiv-2510-20288.description: Abstract In the online metric matching problem, n n servers and n n requests lie in a metric space. Servers are available upfront, and requests arrive sequentially. An arriving request must be matched immediately and irrevocably to an available server, incurring a cost equal to their distance. The goal is to minimize the total matching cost.

arxiv-2601-11168.title: Null Lagrangians in free Novikov algebras
arxiv-2601-11168.creator: Askar Dzhumadil’daev, Nurlan Ismailov
arxiv-2601-11168.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Askar Dzhumadil’daev, Nurlan Ismailov. We study the symmetrization of the Novikov product. Using the embedding of a free Novikov algebra into a differential algebra over a field of characteristic zero and the Euler operators (variational derivatives), we show that the space of null Lagrangians coincides with the subspace of elements closed under the symmetrized product a ∘ b = a ​ b + b ​ a a\circ b=ab+ba . We also completely describe its module structure over symmetric group.

pmc-10537638.title: Genetic Variability of the Internal Transcribed Spacer and Pyruvate:Ferredoxin Oxidoreductase Partial Gene of Trichomonas vaginalis from Female Patients
pmc-10537638.creator: Fernando Martinez-Hernandez, Fabiola Sanchez-Aguillon, Joel Martinez-Ocaña, Nelly Raquel Gonzalez-Arenas, Mirza Romero-Valdovinos, Eduardo Lopez-Escamilla, Pablo Maravilla, Guiehdani Villalobos, Graham H Mitchell
pmc-10537638.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In the present study, we evaluated the genetic variability of the internal transcribed spacer (ITS) region and the pyruvate:ferredoxin oxidoreductase (pfor) A gene of Trichomonas vaginalis from female patients and its possible implications in the host–parasite relationship. Phylogenetic and genetics of populations analyses were performed by analyzing sequences of the ITS region and partial pfor A gene of clinical samples with T. vaginalis, as previously documented. Alignments of protein sequences and prediction of three-dimensional structure were also performed.

pmc-12414728.title: Simple Bagged Movement Models for Telemetry Data
pmc-12414728.creator: Andrew B. Whetten, Trevor J. Hefley, David A. Haukos, Dustin E. Brewer
pmc-12414728.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Determining which statistical methods are appropriate for data is both user and data dependent and prone to change as new methodology becomes available. This process encompasses model ideation, model selection, and determining appropriate use of statistical methods. Literature on models for animal movement emerging in the past two decades has yielded a rich collection of statistical methods garnering much deserved positive attention. Among such efforts, there is limited investigation of the broader place for simple machine learning methodology in animal movement modeling.

pmc-12507239.title: Cell-free DNA screening for trisomies 21, 18, and 13: Clinical application and accuracy evaluation
pmc-12507239.creator: Xiangmei Sun, Yuyi Ying, Caiping Chen, Xiaoliang Shi, Yee Gary Ang, Yee Gary Ang, Yee Gary Ang
pmc-12507239.description: BackgroundCell-free DNA (cf-DNA) screening for common trisomies has been increasingly assimilated into prenatal care. In this study, we evaluated the Z-score accuracy and the effectiveness of non-invasive prenatal testing (NIPT) for trisomies 21, 18, and 13 using cf-DNA, and further analyze pregnancy outcomes of NIPT-positive pregnant women.

pmc-12522843.title: The relationship between physical activity and academic achievement in medical students: a single-institution cross-sectional study in Sudan
pmc-12522843.creator: Saud Mohammed Raja, Mohammed Ahmed Elfaki, Alaa Ibrahim, Hibaallah Maroof, Abrar Abdelrahim
pmc-12522843.description: BackgroundRegular physical activity has been consistently shown to improve cognitive ability among populations of various age groups, including university students. This is particularly important among medical students, who face high academic demands and a relatively stressful environment. Some evidence suggests that regular physical activity has a positive impact on academic success during medical school.

pmc-12530398.title: Multiple DMARD discontinuations in rheumatoid arthritis: how often and in what patients? Results from a national clinical RA register
pmc-12530398.creator: Emma Wettersand, Daniela di Giuseppe, Johan Askling, Katerina Chatzidionysiou
pmc-12530398.description: ObjectivesMultiple discontinuations of biologic (b-) or targeted synthetic (ts-) disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (DMARDs) may indicate difficult-to-treat disease. We aimed to assess the occurrence of b/tsDMARD discontinuations in patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA), specifically how this varies by definition, across patient subsets and over time.

pmc-13155844.title: Coefficient-metric gradient-based digital wavefront correction for full-field swept-source optical coherence tomography
pmc-13155844.creator: Guozheng Xu, Jem Love, Thomas J Smart, Destiny Hsu, Myeong Jin Ju, Marinko V Sarunic
pmc-13155844.description: Full-field swept source optical coherence tomography (FF-SS-OCT) achieves fast acquisition of depth-resolved volumetric data. It preserves the phase stability across en face features, which enables digital wavefront correction during post-processing. Traditional digital wavefront correction methods, such as coordinate search, are reliable but time-consuming. We present CoMGrad, a novel GPU-accelerated coefficient-metric gradient-based optimisation method for digital wavefront correction for FF-SS-OCT.

pmc-13178571.title: Solar-mechanical H2O2 production powered by defect dipole polarization in a nonpolar semiconductor
pmc-13178571.creator: Cheng Chen, Junjie Ni, Peifang Wang, Kaiye Gu, Shicheng Yan, Yanhui Ao
pmc-13178571.description: Piezo-photocatalytic H2O2 production faces a central challenge: inadequate visible-light absorption and insufficient driving forces for charge separation, especially in wide-bandgap nonpolar semiconductors. To address this, we propose a strategy that constructs Cu+-oxygen vacancy defect dipoles within nonpolar ZrO2 to enable piezo-photo coupling.

pmc-13274660.title: Addressing Behavioral and Psychiatric Symptoms in Dystonia: A Case Report of Fahr Disease
pmc-13274660.creator: Tara Khoeini, Mohammad Javad Sinaeefar
pmc-13274660.description: Abnormal calcium deposits in areas of the brain that control movement, including basal ganglia and cerebellum, are the hallmark of Fahr's syndrome. This report highlights the importance of clinicians being vigilant regarding behavioral and neuropsychiatric symptoms when evaluating cases of dystonia. These important clues indicate underlying inherited and neurodegenerative disorders.

pmc-13530805.title: Poster 58. Preoperative Corticosteroid Injection History Does Not Influence Meniscal Allograft Transplantation Survivorship or Failure Rates
pmc-13530805.creator: Vishal Sundaram, Isabella Jazrawi, Rushani K. Cameron, Cody Perskin, Eric J. Strauss, Guillem Lomas, Laith Jazrawi, Michael Alaia, Kirk A. Campbell
pmc-13530805.description: Objective:Meniscal allograft transplantation (MAT) is a joint-preserving option for patients with symptomatic meniscal deficiency unresponsive to nonoperative care. By restoring tibiofemoral load transmission, MAT can relieve pain, improve function, and potentially delay osteoarthritis progression. However, graft survivorship remains variable, with failure rates of 10-30% at mid- to long-term follow-up.
